Sandbox_Parkour_EnableFrontFlip_tooltip: Allows Parkour_FrontFlip to be selected for a successful running vault over a low fence.
Sandbox_Parkour_EnablePlaceholder_toolti: Allows the temporary placeholder clip to be selected. Replace Parkour_Placeholder.glb with a future animation while keeping the same name.
Sandbox_Parkour_DebugLogging_tooltip: Writes the selected vault variant to console.txt. Useful while the placeholder and Front Flip look identical.
